LESSON: LOCATION AND SIZE OF THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Location and size of the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Location and size of the County, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to learn the size and location of a county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm and list sub- counties in their county,

2. use relevant print or digital resources to identify the location of the county in relation to neighbouring counties,

3. discuss the size of the county in relation to the neighbouring counties,

4. sketch, colour, and display the map of the county in class,

5. play games on the location of the county in relation to neighbouring counties.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm and list sub- counties in their county,
2. use relevant print or digital resources to identify the location of the county in relation to neighbouring counties,
3. discuss the size of the county in relation to the neighbouring counties,
4. sketch, colour, and display the map of the county in class,
5. play games on the location of the county in relation to neighbouring counties.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Location and size of the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learners develop simple games as they play games on the location of the county in relation to the

neighbouring counties

● Learning to learn: Learners search for the location and size of their county

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

● Effective Communication: Learners brainstorm to identify sub-counties in their county.
